programs.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings embark on an exciting adventure across the world, while causing chaos in each other's lives on their tour.
Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house.
